description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sharuum.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
